property_summary: Filling a SHORT order must never write an expiration under the short order's own hash (P stores it under the opposite/long position id), but M stores block.timestamp+duration at the short order hash, so c.positionExpirations(uint256(c.hashOrder(shortOrder))) != 0 for any short fill in M.
change_summary: Always store the expiration under the long order hash instead of conditionally choosing between orderHash and positionId, so for short fills the key written changes.
